note: RASAero files were imported with the wrong surface finish. 47 of the 60 tester .CDX1 files carry one of the two strings that were wrong, and one of them matters: "Smooth Paint" was read as 20 micron paint where the desktop reads 5 micron and RASAero itself says 6.35 - measured on a tester's file, total drag falls 8.5 percent at Mach 0.3 and 14.5 percent at Mach 0.8, so those rockets had their apogee under-predicted. Re-open any RASAero file you have imported; the finish is set at import. Also, a RockSim parachute now weighs the shroud lines the file describes instead of the kernel's default - up to 4 percent of a small rocket's dry mass.
